title: Mary Says Yes
book: The New Testament, January 2027 (Come and See!)
p1: In the little town of Nazareth lived a young woman named Mary. She was going to marry Joseph.
One day the angel Gabriel came to her. “Hello, Mary! The Lord is with you.” Mary was afraid.
Gabriel said, “Fear not. You will have a baby boy. Name Him Jesus. He will be the Son of the Highest, a King forever.”
p2: Mary asked, “How can this be?” Gabriel said, “With Heavenly Father, nothing is impossible.” Mary trusted Him. She said, “I am the Lord’s servant. Let it be as you said.” That was a brave yes!
Heavenly Father sometimes asks us to do hard things. Tonight, think of one brave thing you can try. You can say yes, like Mary.
note: Rewritten the picture-book way and rated 9-10 by a reviewer that did not write it (29 Oct 2026).
